# Material icon sources

This application includes fourteen unmodified generated Kotlin vector icon sources from **AndroidX Compose Material Icons Extended Android 1.7.8** by the Android Open Source Project.

- Copyright 2025 The Android Open Source Project.
- License: Apache License, Version 2.0. Full text: [LICENSE](LICENSE).
- Official source archive: https://dl.google.com/dl/android/maven2/androidx/compose/material/material-icons-extended-android/1.7.8/material-icons-extended-android-1.7.8-sources.jar
- Upstream project: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/support/
- Local sources: `app/src/main/java/androidx/compose/material/icons/outlined/`.

Included icons: ArrowUpward, AutoAwesome, ChatBubbleOutline, CloudOff, History, MicNone, Pause, Shield, Spa, Stop, StopCircle, TrackChanges, Tune, WbTwilight.

Each source file retains its original copyright and license header. The sources were selected without modification to avoid packaging and dexing the complete extended icon library. The remaining icons are supplied by the normal `material-icons-core` dependency.

These UI icons are separate from the original procedural Ritsu placeholder artwork.
